license_note: The Reka Terms of Use, last updated September 2026, govern API access to Reka's models: use requires an account with billing details, commercial use runs under the Business Terms, Reka may use customer content to train its models, and disputes go to binding arbitration with class-action waiver. It grants no licence to model weights for redistribution or self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: API access to Reka Flash 3 through Reka-operated inference infrastructure

access_boundary: This record represents the reka-flash-3 API release. The Reka Edge and Core lines, the multimodal Vision services, third-party open models served through the same API, and weight checkpoints some other line publishes are separate boundaries.
strengths: First-party API docs name reka-flash-3 with its context, modalities, and feature flags, served on infrastructure Reka operates
OpenAI-compatible endpoint with structured outputs and tool use, documented with copy-paste client examples
tradeoffs: No weights are published, so self-operation is unavailable and the API list can retire the model without a stated notice period
The terms let Reka train on customer content and send disputes to individual arbitration, which enterprise buyers must weigh
